title: 第十章 摧枯拉朽

content_zh:
果然，话音未落，只听一声呼啸声，那个紫衣青年脚下一踏，身形爆冲，双手化成一双鹰爪，练的正是一手初级功法鹰爪功，配合上后天五重后期的实力，连青石板都可以抓穿，威力极大，他也是靠着鹰爪功在张家内门弟子中闻名的。
紫衣青年身似大鹰，双手似爪，狠狠抓下，空气在震荡爆鸣，脸上尽是狞笑，他几乎可以看到叶希文被他一爪抓的重伤的场景。
仿佛一只大鹰瞬间扑杀而至，真气都凝聚成鹰状。
叶希文瞬间出手，带起一阵噼里啪啦的雷暴声，一只手探出，直接撕开紫衣青年护体的真气，一把抓住了紫衣青年的脖颈。
双方实力实在差太多了，只在刹那间叶希文就破开防御。
紫衣青年被叶希文单手抓住脖颈，叶希文的大手犹如铁箍一般牢牢的将他的脖子给箍住，浑身都使不上劲，气都喘不上来，在这样子下去，他甚至会被叶希文生生捏死。
这是叶希文第一次和人动手，但是五虎之力配合上第八响的奔雷手，完全以实力力压了这个紫衣青年，这是绝对实力的差距。
那个张家少主和青衣青年都是一脸难以置信的样子，这简直就跟神话传说一样。
“住手，快放开他！”青衣青年大喝道。
“那就还给你！”叶希文袍服之下，肌肉绷到最紧，将紫衣青年直接扔了出去。
“嘭！”紫衣青年眨眼间就飞到青衣青年的面前，青衣青年迎起双手一接，顿时在一阵‘卡拉’，‘卡拉’的声音青衣青年的双手直接被巨大的力道撞断。
现在叶希文的一身力气已经超过了五虎之力，超过了两千五百斤，那个青衣青年不过是后天五重罢了，力量不过是三虎之力，怎么接的住，所以才一下子就给砸断了手臂。
“卡拉！”骨头断裂的渗人的声音，紫衣青年的背部狠狠撞到了青衣青年的双臂上，脊椎直接断裂，断骨刺穿内脏，顿时一口鲜血喷出，昏迷了过去，死生不知。
这话说来长，但是这也不过是几个呼吸之间的事情罢了。
那张家少主顿时大怒，不过是短短时间，两个下属，居然一个昏迷了过去，一个双手折断，哀嚎不已，对他来说，简直是在他脸上狠狠甩了一巴掌。
“你真是不知死活！”张家少主大怒说道，一身真气扩散开来，比起紫衣青年和青衣青年强了不是一点半点，后天六重的实力十分惊人，已经有资格成为核心弟子了。“我要打断你的手脚，废去你的武功，再将你剥皮抽筋！”
张家少主一拳轰出，刚猛的拳劲，将空气都轰的沸腾了起来，真气几乎要贯穿长空，拳劲扭成一股劲道，犹如一条气龙朝着叶希文轰去。
“雷厉风行！”叶希文大喝一声，奔雷手出手，伴随着轰隆隆的雷声一举击溃了张家少主的气龙狠狠的撞到了杨易的拳头上。
“嘭！”一股犹如是金铁交鸣一般的声音，张家少主顿时双手都折断，一口鲜血喷出，身体倒飞了出去，眼中满是不可思议的神情，“怎么可能，八响，你居然练到了第八响！”
张家少主绝对没想到，叶希文居然能将奔雷手练到圆满的境界，打出第八响，只怕是很多核心弟子都做不到吧，奔雷手不是什么高深的秘籍，张家之中也有而且更可怕的是，叶希文居然也有五虎之力之力，不是天生神力的那种分散的力量，而是拧成了五股劲道的力量，这才是他一击就被打折了双手的根本原因。

“你知道也没用了！”叶希文冷笑一声，追了上去，奔雷手催发到了极致，对着还在横飞的张家少主一掌拍下。
“嘭！”张家的胸口都被轰碎，胸骨碎裂，骨血横飞，心脏更被叶希文直接打爆，顿时是死的不能再死了。
片刻之间，形势逆转，刚才还是三人围杀叶希文，现在却一死一昏迷一重伤。
“不可能的，你。。。你居然杀了少主！”那个青衣青年哀嚎着说道。
叶希文面无表情，慢慢走向唐宽。
“这位，是我们错了，你放过我们吧，我们都是受了少主的指使，我们一定会守口如瓶，绝对不会说出去的！”那青衣青年脸上终于露出害怕的神情，只是那害怕的神情之中，一丝怨毒一闪而过，却被叶希文捕捉到了。

content_en:
Sure enough, before he finished speaking, there was only a whistling sound. The young man in purple stepped on his feet, his figure exploded, and his hands turned into a pair of eagle claws. He was practicing the basic skill Eagle Claw Technique. Combined with the acquired strength of the late fifth level, he could even scratch through bluestone slabs. It was extremely powerful. He also relied on the Eagle Claw Technique to become famous among the inner disciples of the Zhang family.
The young man in purple had a body like a big eagle, and his hands were like claws. He grabbed hard, the air shook and roared, and his face was filled with a sinister smile. He could almost see Ye Xiwen being seriously injured by his claws.
It was like a big eagle swooped down instantly, and all the energy condensed into the shape of an eagle.
Ye Xiwen took action instantly, causing a burst of crackling thunderstorms. He reached out with one hand, directly tore away the infuriating energy of the purple-clothed young man's body, and grabbed the purple-clothed young man's neck.
The strength of the two sides was so different that Ye Xiwen broke through the defense in an instant.
The young man in purple clothes was grabbed by Ye Xiwen's neck with one hand. Ye Xiwen's big hand tightly held his neck like an iron hoop. He could not exert any strength and could not breathe. If this continued, he would even be squeezed to death by Ye Xiwen.
This was Ye Xiwen's first time fighting against someone, but the power of the Five Tigers, combined with the Eighth Ring's Thunder Hand, completely overwhelmed the purple-clothed young man with their strength. This was an absolute difference in strength.
The young master of the Zhang family and the young man in Tsing Yi both looked in disbelief. This was just like a myth.
"Stop, let him go!" the young man in Tsing Yi shouted.
"Then I'll give it back to you!" Under Ye Xiwen's robe, his muscles tensed to the maximum, and he threw the young man in purple directly out.
"Bang!" The young man in purple flew in front of the young man in green clothes in the blink of an eye. The young man in green clothes raised his hands and took them. Suddenly there was a "kara" and "kara" sound, and the young man in green clothes was directly broken by the huge force.
Now Ye Xiwen's strength has exceeded the strength of the Five Tigers, exceeding 2,500 kilograms. The young man in green is only the fifth level acquired, and his strength is only the strength of the Three Tigers. How could he catch it, so he broke his arm in one fell swoop.
"Kara!" There was a piercing sound of broken bones. The purple-clothed young man's back hit the green-clothed young man's arms hard. His spine was broken directly, and the broken bones pierced his internal organs. A mouthful of blood spurted out immediately, and he passed out, not knowing whether he was dead or alive.
This is a long story, but it only takes a few breaths.
The young master of the Zhang family was immediately furious. In just a short period of time, one of the two subordinates actually passed out, and the other had his hands broken and was wailing. To him, it was like a slap in the face.
"You really don't know how to live or die!" The young master of the Zhang family said angrily, and his true energy spread out. He was not a little bit stronger than the young man in purple and green. His acquired sixth level strength was amazing, and he was already qualified to become a core disciple. "I'm going to break your hands and feet, take away your martial arts, and then skin you and cramp you!"
The young master of the Zhang family punched out, and the fierce punch made the air boil. The true energy almost penetrated the sky, and the punch twisted into a powerful force, blasting towards Ye Xiwen like an air dragon.
"Thunder and force!" Ye Xiwen shouted, and took action with his thunder hand. With the rumbling thunder, he defeated the young master of the Zhang family's air dragon and slammed into Yang Yi's fist.
"Bang!" There was a sound like the clash of gold and iron. The young master of the Zhang family suddenly broke his hands, a mouthful of blood spurted out, and his body flew backwards. His eyes were filled with an incredible look, "How is it possible, out of eight rings, you actually reached the eighth ring!"
The young master of the Zhang family never expected that Ye Xiwen could actually practice the Thunder Hand to the perfect level and hit the eighth ring. I am afraid that many core disciples cannot do it. The Thunder Hand is not a profound secret book, which is also available in the Zhang family. What is even more frightening is that Ye Xiwen actually also has the power of the Five Tigers. It is not the dispersed power of natural divine power, but the twisting power.It became the force of five strong forces, which was the fundamental reason why his hands were broken in one blow.
"It's useless if you know it!" Ye Xiwen sneered and chased after him, using his thunder hand to the extreme, he slapped the young master of the Zhang family who was still flying around.
"Bang!" The Zhang family's chest was shattered, the sternum was shattered, bones and blood flew everywhere, and the heart was directly blown out by Ye Xiwen, and they were immediately dead and could no longer die.
In a moment, the situation reversed. Just now, three people were surrounding Ye Xiwen, but now one was dead, one was unconscious, and the other was seriously injured.
"It's impossible, you...you actually killed the young master!" the young man in green wailed.
Ye Xiwen had no expression on his face and slowly walked towards Tang Kuan.
"This one, we were wrong. Please let us go. We were all instructed by the young master. We will definitely keep our mouths shut and will never tell anyone!" The young man in green finally showed a look of fear on his face, but in that look of fear, a trace of resentment flashed through, but Ye Xiwen caught it.
